species.real: Jeremiah Colman of Norwich is supposed to have said he made his fortune not from the mustard people ate but from the mustard they left on the side of the plate.
species.name: Mustling

dex.text: Small, round and the exact yellow of a mustard tin. Hold it too close to your face and your eyes water for a week.
dex.fact: Mustard seed only turns fiery when it's ground and mixed with cold water: that wakes an enzyme that makes the hot oil that goes up your nose.

species.real: Mustard belongs to the cabbage family, the brassicas, alongside broccoli, turnips and rocket, which is why its yellow flowers look so like oilseed rape.
species.name: Mustardrake

dex.text: Snorts yellow fire up its own nose and enjoys it. Norwich folk keep one by the Sunday roast, at a respectful distance.
dex.fact: Norwich mustard has been milled by the Wensum at Carrow since the 1850s, and the mustard works once ran its own school for its workers' children.
